summary: Phase 5 Compliance module — 41/41 backend pytest passed (RBAC, seed counts, KYB checklist enforcement, wallet screen stub, limits edit+history, Pydantic validation). Frontend: discovered a CRITICAL app-breaking runtime error in the shared Badge component (`tone='info'` not defined in TONES → TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading bg)') that crashed /admin/compliance/kyt, /admin/compliance/alerts, and /admin/compliance/risk. Applied a single-line fix in /app/packages/ui/src/Badge.tsx to add `info` tone (same palette as `primary`). After the fix, all 6 compliance sub-pages render correctly: KYT shows 7 rules + 25 alerts + 100 travel-rule txs + wallet screening returning 'unavailable'; Risk donut + top10 + SAR/STR buttons present; Alerts page renders with 10 filter chips + bulk-ack/bulk-resolve buttons; Limits shows 208 caps (52×4) + 52 history buttons with inline edit working; AlertsBell shows count=3 and 5 latest items.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: `tone='info'` was used by KYT/Alerts/Risk pages (SEV_TONE maps severity 'info' → 'info'; risk page maps 'medium' → 'info') but the TONES record only had default|primary|success|warning|danger. This caused `c = TONES['info']` to be undefined and threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'bg')` which crashed the entire page via the React error boundary. Added an `info` entry (same palette as primary) to TONES.

After Badge fix the page renders + filter chips (10) + bulk buttons are visible, but [data-testid^='alert-cb-'] returned 0 in automation. Possibly the page renders an empty list under the default filter state, or rows are inside a virtualized table not yet hydrated. Backend GET /admin/alerts returned 12 items in pytest, so data is present. Worth a manual review.

Backend correctly returns 403 for client_admin on all /admin/compliance/* and /admin/alerts/* endpoints (verified in 13/13 pytest cases). However the Next.js route /admin/compliance/kyc is NOT redirected/blocked client-side for client_admin — they land on the page and see an empty 'No KYC cases' state instead of a clear 'no permission' message. Security is intact (backend rejects), but UX is misleading.

critical_code_review_comments: BUG (now FIXED): /app/packages/ui/src/Badge.tsx — TONES map was missing an `info` entry while consumers in kyt/page.tsx, alerts/page.tsx, and risk/page.tsx referenced tone='info'. The Tone type union (`keyof typeof TONES`) should have caught this at compile time, but the SEV_TONE map in those pages was typed as `Record<string, 'info'|'warning'|'danger'>` which casts away the type-check on tone prop. Recommend: import the Tone type from Badge.tsx and use it in SEV_TONE so TypeScript would flag missing palette entries before runtime.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE — /app/packages/ui/src/Badge.tsx defined TONES with keys [default, primary, success, warning, danger] but three Phase 5 pages mapped severities/buckets to tone='info' (kyt/page.tsx line 21, alerts/page.tsx line 9, risk/page.tsx line 22). The SEV_TONE Record type used a string-literal union that was wider than `keyof typeof TONES`, so TypeScript didn't flag the mismatch. At runtime `TONES['info']` was undefined → `c.bg` threw TypeError, the Next.js error boundary caught it and the entire KYT/Alerts/Risk page crashed. REPRO: visit /admin/compliance/kyt as super_admin → page renders only the error overlay 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading bg)' from Badge.tsx:38. MITIGATION (applied): added `info: { bg: 'color-mix(in srgb, #2B6BFF 14%, transparent)', fg: '#2B6BFF' }` to the TONES record. Better long-term fix: import the `Tone` type from Badge.tsx into the consumer SEV_TONE maps so TS catches future mismatches at compile time.
